schema.principle: Append-only. Never mutate. History is inviolable.
schema.reconstruction: State at time T = replay all events where timestamp ≤ T, in tick order

content.doc: Event Sourcing is the foundation of ChronoVision. Instead of storing the current state, we store every change as an immutable event. The state at any moment in history is reconstructed by replaying events in tick order up to that timestamp. This makes time-travel debugging deterministic — not approximate. The tick number ensures events are always replayed in the Fixed Sacred Order.
